body.heading: About this sheet
paragraphs: Free SparkKindly Kids word play printable: Word Scramble 07.
Words to unscramble, hunt and play with — letters are toys, and this sheet is the toy box.

body.heading: How to use it
paragraphs: Print the sheet and say the letters out loud. Writing the letters on scrap paper and sliding them around makes unscrambling much easier.

takeaway: Playing with letters — moving them, sounding them, laughing at silly results — is real reading practice in disguise.
materials: Scrap paper or letter tiles for sliding letters around
supervision: Sound out the first word together, then hand over the pencil — hints beat answers every time.
safetyNotes: Print at 100% size (not "fit to page") so the sheet keeps its true size and the pictures stay the size they were drawn.
screenFreeExtension: Hunt for one of the sheet's words in a storybook tonight — first to spot it reads the page aloud.
